foreignObject.div: Figure 5. Guest instructions on an emulated Cortex-M0, one QEMU run per program with the empty-corpus baseline subtracted. Left: program length explains only R² = 0.80 of the cost, because the ISA is a compression format — a REPEAT byte is cheap to store and expensive to run. Right: two terms explain R² = 0.999 — 50 instructions to decode and dispatch each bytecode instruction, and 18 per point of geometry emitted. That is where a device's cycles go.
